meta.title: Business automation and custom software
meta.description: Custom software, integrations and AI to simplify how your business works. Tell Kremisi which processes you want to improve.

hero.eyebrow: Custom software · Automation · AI for SMEs
hero.description: We build custom software, connect tools and integrate AI into the way small and medium businesses work. We start with what you do every day.
hero.note: From repetitive tasks to disconnected information: let’s start with what you want to simplify.

solutions.title: Where work gets stuck, we can begin.
solutions.intro: You don’t need to start with a technology. Start with a task that takes more attention than it should.

connections.problem: The same data. Entered again, and again.
connections.name: Integrations and automation
connections.description: We connect your tools and design workflows to move information, update data and handle repetitive steps. We assess what can work with the systems you already use.

custom.problem: Your process doesn’t fit off-the-shelf software.
custom.name: Custom software
custom.description: We design tools around how you work: operational interfaces, platforms and business logic built around your team’s needs.

ai.problem: Plenty of information. Little time to use it.
ai.name: AI and data, with a purpose
ai.description: We assess how AI and data analysis can help process information and support repetitive tasks. Together, we define limits, checks and the steps that need a person.

case.title: From a process diagram to a model you can analyse.
case.description: A process can be described as a diagram of activities and steps. We designed and developed BPMN2Petri to convert these diagrams into a model that can be used to analyse the process.
case.context: In technical terms, it converts BPMN diagrams into Petri nets. It is an example of custom software for a specific task: turning one representation of a process into another that supports verification.
case.imageAlt: Actual BPMN2Petri interface showing a BPMN diagram and its corresponding Petri net
case.caption: BPMN2Petri · The project’s conversion interface

method.title: Understand the work first. Choose the technology next.

understand.title: Understand the process
understand.description: Tell us about your tasks, tools and points of friction. We clarify the problem and who deals with it every day.

define.title: Define the priorities
define.description: We assess feasibility, integrations and constraints. We share a proposal with a clear scope and next steps.

build.title: Build and verify
build.description: We design and develop the solution, reviewing real workflows and checking how it works with your team.

contact.title: What would you like to simplify?
contact.description: Tell us how you work today, which tools you use and where you lose time. It will help us understand where to begin.
